headline: Full time: FC Northbridge 1-1 Harbour City
body: Goals: Strand 13', Nakamura 46'. Possession was FC Northbridge 48%, Harbour City 52%. Pass accuracy was FC Northbridge 66%, Harbour City 70%. Marchetti’s assist to Strand created a chance to score 6.7% and was judged reasonable; at 37' carrying on would have raised the chance to score from 8.9% to 11.5%, and Nakamura’s goal came from a chance to score 4.6% with no tested defensive tweak clearly better.
